🧴 Your skin shows moderate wrinkles — time to be proactive!
🌿 Preventative routine:
  - Use a hydrating or anti-aging cleanser.

🩺 Your skin shows severe wrinkles — it’s time for serious care.

  - Consider prescription retinoids or peptides.
  - Use ceramide-rich moisturizers and avoid stripping cleansers.

  - Retinol, peptides, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid.
  - Avoid alcohol-based toners or products with fragrance.
🍽 Lifestyle changes:
  - Get 7–9 hours of sleep.
  - Drink at least 2L of water per day.
  - Minimize stress and avoid smoking.
